name: Wellness to Work
whoFor: Kirklees residents aged 18 and over with a health condition or disability affecting their ability to get or keep a job.
eligibility: Aged 18 or over, living in Kirklees, with a health condition or disability affecting ability to get or keep a job
Out of work due to ill health, OR in work but at risk of falling out of work due to ill health (including musculoskeletal conditions and/or vocational rehabilitation needs)
Committed to remaining in or entering paid employment

projects.name: Wellness to Work
projects.overview: A personalised holistic assessment of barriers (health, confidence, skills, general wellbeing), clinical triage where needed, and a dedicated Employment Navigator and health professional who build an action plan. Includes MSK fast-track physiotherapy and occupational therapy vocational rehabilitation. Connects people to partners such as Get Set Goal, Kirklees Active Leisure, Kirklees College and Third Sector Leaders.
projects.duration: 3-6 months, with coordination for up to 3 months afterwards, plus in-work support for people who get a job

notes: Status before November 2026: Live - open to referrals
